name: Rabiul
look: A 3D CGI character modeled in the signature Pixar/Disney aesthetic with high-quality subsurface scattering on the warm skin tone to capture lighting nuances realistically. The face uses smooth topology for soft deformations around the eyes and mouth during animation. Hair is rendered with strand-based simulation for a fluffy, realistic texture that interacts with light. Eyes are glossy and reflective, conveying deep emotion through iris movement. Outfit consists of casual streetwear fitting the modern protagonist archetype, ensuring the character is distinct in any scene.
features_summary: Young adult male with warm brown skin tone, neatly styled black hair with a slight side part, expressive dark eyes, and a well-defined but approachable jawline typical of a stylized Pixar protagonist.
